examples.title: Applied scenario
examples.scenario: Title: Rachel Writes the Real Meeting Scenario: The cancelled campaign board leans against Rachel's wall, still covered with color chips from the mood board. A budget email waits beside a blank notecard. She must decide whether to request a business-rationale meeting or the meeting she actually needs, so she writes three words first: grief, fear, anger.
